modern: Either all things come from one intelligent source and come together as in one body, and the part ought not to find fault with what is done for the benefit of the whole; or there are only atoms, and nothing but mixture and dispersion. Why, then, are you disturbed? Say to the ruling faculty: Are you dead, are you corrupted, are you playing the hypocrite, have you become a beast, do you herd and feed with the rest?
original: Either all things proceed from one intelligent source and come together as in one body, and the part ought not to find fault with what is done for the benefit of the whole; or there are only atoms, and nothing else than mixture and dispersion. Why, then, art thou disturbed? Say to the ruling faculty, Art thou dead, art thou corrupted, art thou playing the hypocrite, art thou become a beast, dost thou herd and feed with the rest?
